answer_1.quote: empathetic response generation aims to comprehend the emotional and cognitive states of the user in dialogue utterances and provide appropriate responses.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation. Following previous methods , we use perplexity (PPL), accuracy (Acc), distinct-1 (Dist-1)/distinct-2 (Dist-2) to evaluate response fluency, emotion classification accuracy, and response diversity, respectively.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Metrics. We invite three professional crowdworkers to evaluate the response quality.
answer_4.guideline: Consistent with previous methods , we conduct A/B testing to compare the baseline and IAMM. For a response, if IAMM has better quality, the crowdworkers add one point to Win. If IAMM is worse than the comparison model, they add one point to Lose. To evaluate quality, we consider empathy (Emp.), relevance (Rel.), and fluency (Flu.)
